headline: Odigma Consultancy Solutions releases September quarter financials
summary: Odigma Consultancy Solutions Limited has officially filed its financial results for the period ending September 30, 2026. The filing was submitted to the National Stock Exchange as part of the company's mandatory regulatory compliance. Retail investors can access the detailed balance sheet and profit-loss statement through the exchange portal.
why_it_matters: Review the filing to assess the company's current financial health.
